snippet.title: Dendron 64 Demo || Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4600910/Dendron_64/

Hi again!

Now that the Steam page has been set up, I wanted to do something as a thank you to you all for sticking with me on this journey. As such, I've made the decision to release the alpha build of the game as a demo on Steam to preface the future release of the full game!

Due to the alpha build being incredibly buggy (particularly after porting it over to a PC version), some areas of the game are too unstable to play through. For this reason, I've used a basic version of the Godot engine emulator we're using for the full game to add screens where the game's content is inaccessible. I apologise for any inconvenience caused by this, but this decision was made for the sake of the game being at least somewhat playable in its current state.

At the moment there is still no confirmed release date for the full game, but we will let you know as soon as possible if that changes!
